studies.name: Shōgi
studies.line: The samurai's board game. Each level is a rank of nine squares, its piece standing on the square of its level; the output in play is promoted, its character red. A muted app's piece is turned away.

studies.name: Soroban
studies.line: The abacus. Each level is counted out in beads on two rods, tens and units, pushed to the beam; the master's beads lacquered red. Unit dots part the readings.

studies.name: Odoshi
studies.line: Armour lacing. The sheet hangs like a samurai's shoulder guard: a crown plate, then a lame of small scales per choice, laced in scarlet silk as far as its level; the output in use cross-stitched at its foot.

studies.name: Kasumi
studies.line: The mist bands of a picture scroll and gold screens: each choice a band of gold leaf drawn as far as its level, drifting in from alternate sides; the one in use gilded whole and sealed.
